terminal_name: Eni Baleine field Phase 3 (offshore Côte d'Ivoire)
issue: Checked as a possible LNG lead and confirmed OUT OF SCOPE for the terminals tracker. Eni + Petroci + Vitol approved FID for Baleine Phase 3 on 25 May 2026 (~US$4bn; ~150,000 bbl/d oil and ~200 MMcf/d gas via a new FPSO). All Baleine gas (Phases 1–3) is allocated to the DOMESTIC market for power generation — there is no liquefaction, no LNG export terminal, and no LNG import terminal associated with it. It is an upstream oil-and-gas FPSO development, not an LNG terminal. Recorded so a future sweep does not re-investigate Baleine as an LNG-terminal candidate.
suggested_action: No GEM LNG-terminal action. Do not stage as a terminal. Verified source: https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2026/05/eni-and-partners-approve-investment-for-baleine-phase-3-in-c-te-d-ivoire.html
